roads.name: Ousel Falls View Road
words: Curve after curve after curve: 41 in 4.2 miles, about 10 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 6,750 to 7,719 ft, with 1,163 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 75°F.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.19 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.
